title: LiteCowork Saved View Artifact v1
$comment: TARGET contract, updated 2026-11-24 under user-delegated direction A-84. Saved Views remain V1 under Feature 007 B-21. An optional input_snapshot is allowed only when the user explicitly opts in while saving; it contains declared numeric inputs only and is part of immutable ArtifactVersion content. It is absent by default. The component never persists or sends input state. Feature 007/016 cross-owner review and canonical Rust/TypeScript validators remain required before this schema is implementation-authoritative. Cross-field checks listed in Feature 007 contracts/saved-view.md are required in addition to JSON Schema.

semantic_snapshot.description: Exact committed semantic answer text used for safe fallback. JSON Schema maxLength counts characters; the owner validator must additionally enforce a strict 1 MiB UTF-8 byte limit.

input_snapshot.description: Optional, explicitly user-saved numeric control values. Omitted unless the user opts in. The owner validator must match each entry to exactly one declared numeric input in rich_presentation, require its declaration_digest to match, and enforce the input's minimum/maximum/step before accepting the ArtifactVersion.
